title: HP 212X Yellow High-Yield Toner Cartridge (W2122X), New

comparisons.notes: Genuine HP 212X W2122X yellow high-yield, new, in stock

writeup: Woot has the genuine HP 212X Yellow High Yield toner cartridge (W2122X, UPC 194441428919) new for $229.99. Only a couple were left at posting, with a limit of 3 per customer.
